ui.welcome: 👋 Hello, {name}! 🎮 Welcome to Minecraft Commands! This bot helps you find, understand and copy Minecraft Bedrock (Android) commands. 👇 Pick a category or use 🔍 search.
ui.search_prompt: 🔍 Type a word to search. Examples: tnt, lightning, village, gamemode
ui.search_none:
😕 Nothing found for «{q}».
Try another word or pick a category.
ui.search_expired: ⌛ Search results expired. Please search again.
ui.help: ❓ Help 1️⃣ Pick a category or type a word to search. 2️⃣ Tap the code block — the command gets copied. 3️⃣ Open the chat in Minecraft and paste it. 📱 Marks: ✅ Works ⚠️ Depends on version — may differ between old/new versions ❌ Does not work — not in Bedrock (usually a Java command) ⚠️ Cheats must be enabled in the world. 🎯 Bedrock selectors: r=, rm=, c= (not Java’s distance= and limit=). 📦 A single /fill changes at most 32,768 blocks.
ui.about: ℹ️ Minecraft Commands 🎮 Made for Minecraft Bedrock Edition (especially Android) only. 📚 Commands: {count} 🌐 Languages: O‘zbekcha, English, Русский, العربية ✅ Java commands are not mixed in; incompatible ones are marked ❌. ⚠️ Version-dependent commands are marked ⚠️.
ui.err_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again later or press /start.

desc.c002: Changes the player to Creative mode.
desc.c003: Switches you to Adventure mode (blocks can't be broken freely).
desc.c004: Puts all players into Creative mode.
desc.c005: Spectator mode. Not officially in Bedrock; may not work in many versions.
desc.c006: Sets the default game mode for new players.
desc.c011: Moves time forward by 1000 ticks (about 50 seconds).
desc.c012: Shows the current time of day (in ticks).
desc.c016: Sets clear weather for a very long time (in ticks).
desc.c018: Teleports you to X=0, Y=100, Z=0.
desc.c019: Teleports you to the player named Steve.
desc.c021: Brings all loaded cows to you.
desc.c022: Moves you 10 blocks forward in the direction you look.
desc.c023: Keeps your position and makes you face 0 64 0 (newer versions).
desc.c024: Sets your respawn point to the current spot.
desc.c025: Sets the world spawn to this spot.
desc.c032: Enchants the held weapon with Sharpness V.
desc.c033: Enchants the held tool with Efficiency V.
desc.c034: Adds Mending to the held item.
desc.c035: There is no debug stick in Bedrock (Java Edition only).
desc.c038: Gives very high jumps for 60 seconds.
desc.c044: Summons a cow at your position.
desc.c049: Summons a horse (rideable with a saddle).
desc.c056: Strikes lightning 10 blocks away (along the Z axis).
desc.c057: Strikes every player with lightning (new execute syntax).
desc.c058: Strikes pigs with lightning; they turn into zombified piglins.
desc.c059: Thunderstorm: lightning strikes on its own.
desc.c061: Summons primed TNT that explodes soon.
desc.c062: Places a TNT block at your position.
desc.c064: Fills a 5×5 area with TNT (25 blocks).
desc.c067: Gives flint and steel to ignite TNT.
desc.c068: Places a diamond block at your position.
desc.c069: Places a chest one block above.
desc.c071: Clears all blocks in the area (turns them to air).
desc.c073: Quick build: an instant stone-brick house shell.
desc.c076: Copies the area and pastes it 10 blocks away.
desc.c077: Big flat area: a 121×121 grass layer. Chunks must be loaded; older versions use «grass».
desc.c078: Big flat area: clears hills and trees above (51×51).
desc.c079: Big flat area: lays a dirt layer underneath.
desc.c083: Tag-based replace exists in Java only; it does not work in Bedrock. Use each block separately.
desc.c086: Removes water (flowing water may need flowing_water).
desc.c087: Removes lava (flowing lava may need flowing_lava).
desc.c089: Plants and leaves update much faster (default: 1).
desc.c090: Finds the nearest village. Older versions: /locate village.
desc.c092: Summons an iron golem, the village guard.
desc.c094: Summons a zombie villager (it can be cured).
desc.c096: Bad Omen effect: entering a village starts a raid.
desc.c101: Finds a Nether fortress (run it in the Nether).
desc.c102: Finds an ancient city (1.19 and newer).
desc.c106: You keep your items after dying.
desc.c109: Mobs (creepers etc.) no longer destroy blocks.
desc.c114: Hides command block messages in chat.
desc.c115: Sets difficulty to Peaceful (no hostile mobs).
desc.c117: Removes every mob and entity except players.
desc.c119: Removes all dropped items on the ground.
desc.c120: Kills all mobs within 20 blocks (Bedrock uses r=).
desc.c123: Removes only diamonds from your inventory.
desc.c124: Puts a diamond helmet on your head (older command, changed in some versions).
desc.c128: Gives a command block (needs cheats and Creative).
desc.c131: Sends a message everyone can see in chat.
desc.c132: Writes «* YourName is building a house» in chat.
desc.c133: Shows a big title on every player's screen.
desc.c134: Sends a message in rawtext format (Bedrock format).
desc.c135: Runs a command as each player, at their position (new execute).
desc.c136: Warns in chat if a creeper is nearby.
desc.c137: Gives you the «admin» tag (use tag=admin in selectors).
desc.c139: Old syntax; it does not work in new versions. Use «as ... at ... run».
desc.c140: Saves the area as a structure named «house».
desc.c145: Creates an always-loaded area (for big /fill and /structure).
